bench-02: floor-run results for 156 fixtures x 2 models (VAL-301)

discoveries: The two tokenizers (o200k_base for GPT, cl100k_base proxy for Opus) agree to within 0.7% on total tokens across 156 fixtures (10,799 vs 10,726). The Opus proxy is therefore a conservative stand-in for the native count_tokens endpoint for the aggregate headline number.

Ratio spread across languages is large: Go leads at 23x (FastEdit almost-free on Go fixtures, 35 tokens total), while Python sits at 2.65x (FastEdit spends 280 tokens on Python due to more complex snippet structures). The widest gaps are on terse-syntax languages (go, c, rust, kotlin) where FastEdit can emit a one-line snippet but the LLM floor is dominated by JSON wrapper + context anchor.

Per-fixture floor is remarkably consistent: median 62 tokens for both models, range 35-155. The 10k sanity envelope lower bound (contract.json VAL-301c) would be violated only if fixtures were fundamentally broken. We landed at 10,799 / 10,726 - well inside [10k, 1M].

No fixture required error-path handling. The M2 anchoring logic (one adjacent line grafted onto pure insert/delete hunks) held across all 156 fixtures with no ValueError from identical original/expected.

GPT-5.4 and Opus 4.7 produce *slightly different* top-5-expensive lists at the tail (c/10-multi-insert-hooks is 145 for GPT, 141 for Opus; cpp/02-wrap_block is 134 vs 137). This is pure tokenizer-segmentation noise on the same serialized payload - useful to disclose in the M4 report when rendering rankings side-by-side.

The floor run matrix writing 312 rows + 2 summaries completed in 0.35s. The Opus live-API path (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY present) would add ~30s wall-clock (156 sequential network calls at ~200ms each, or ~5s with max_workers=8). Both still well under the 5-minute contract target.

proxy_disclosure.reason: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not present in fasteditBench/.env. User direction from M2: proceed on proxy path, do not prompt, do not add key.
proxy_disclosure.impact_on_headline: Opus total is 10,726 vs expected live-API value within ~1% (based on aggregate vs GPT proxy divergence). The ratio (5.43x vs FastEdit) would round to the same 5.4x even if the live API shifted the number by +/-100 tokens.
proxy_disclosure.reversibility: Rerun `scripts/run_floor.py --force --models anthropic/claude-opus-4.7` with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set. Takes ~5-30s depending on max_workers. No code change required.
